name: Wailing Caverns
summary: Steam wails through the bluffs above Lushwater Oasis, where the Wailing Caverns twist beneath the Barrens. Naralex, a night elf druid, entered the springs hoping to restore life to the arid plains, but mutations and agitated wildlife now haunt the caverns.

sections.title: The Druids of the Fang
sections.body: Naralex's followers guard him as he sleeps in the Wailing Caverns. His closest disciples were driven mad by the Emerald Nightmare and abandoned their old traditions. Under leaders such as Lady Anacondra, they formed the Druids of the Fang and took on venomous snake aspects. They defend their master from anyone who might break his trance. The waterways now threaten to poison oases across the Barrens. Cenarion Circle allies in Thunder Bluff are concerned, while goblins in Ratchet see an opportunity.

sections.title: The Dream Curdled
sections.body: Steam bursts from underground geysers and escapes through cracks in the rock, sending mournful wails through the caverns. The night elf druid Naralex entered these deep waterways with his faithful followers. He hoped to draw on the subterranean springs and channel the Emerald Dream, bringing bloom to the barren savannas. Instead, the Emerald Nightmare trapped his consciousness. Corruption seeps from the sleeping druid, warping the springs and changing local beasts into deviate horrors.

faq.q: Why is it called the Wailing Caverns?
faq.answer: The Wailing Caverns take their name from shrieks of steam bursting through narrow cracks in the rock ceiling. The cries echo through the stone chambers.

faq.q: Who is Naralex and why is he sleeping here?
faq.answer: Naralex is a night elf druid who sought to turn the Barrens into lush woodland by joining its underground springs to the Emerald Dream. The Emerald Nightmare overwhelmed him in trance, and corruption now flows through him.

faq.q: What are the Druids of the Fang?
faq.answer: The Druids of the Fang are Naralex's former disciples, driven mad by the Emerald Nightmare while he slept. They took on serpent aspects, defend the corrupted caverns, and seek to spread their warped vision of nature.

faq.q: Why are the beasts inside called 'deviate'?
faq.answer: Naralex's corruption has tainted the springs, changing ordinary raptors, crocolisks, and vipers into deviate forms. Their strange coloring, heightened aggression, and unusual scales and hides mark the change.

angles.text: For a druid, the Wailing Caverns show how good intentions can be corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare. Naralex must be awakened, or his twisted disciples put to rest.
For the Horde, the tainted waters threaten the fragile oases that sustain life and travel across the Barrens. Cleansing the caves is urgent for the safety of nearby settlements.
